responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 bootstrap wrapper around the host termios terminal-control subsystem. It allocates and frees termios objects, exposes baud-rate and tcsetattr/tcgetattr operations, supports raw mode, drain/flush/flow-control helpers, and translates large Modula-2 enums for terminal flags and control characters into the corresponding termios bitfields and c_cc entries with feature-tested fallbacks for unsupported constants.
